title: Nucor Invites You to Join Its First Quarter of 2026 Conference Call on the Web
summary: In conjunction with Nucor's (NYSE: NUE) first quarter earnings release, you are invited to listen to its live conference call with host Leon Topalian, Nucor's Chair and Chief Executive Officer. This conference call will include a review of Nucor's results for the first quarter ended April 4, 2026, followed by a question-and-answer session. The event will be available on the internet on April 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time. What: Nucor's First Quarter of 2026 Conference Call When: 10:00 a.m. Eastern Time on Tuesday, April 28, 2026 Where: https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/129924537 or at https://nucor.com/ How: Log on to the web at either of the addresses above Archive: If you are unable to participate during the live webcast, the archived call will be available at http://www.nucor.com.
